title: Side setback, walls up to 3.5 m high (R10-R25)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. ii. For R10-R25, the stated setback distances may be reduced by half the width of an adjoining pedestrian access way to a maximum reduction of 2m (refer to Figure 3.4d). Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, side setback: Wall height up to 3.5m 1m.

replaces.note: wall height and length matrix -> flat setback by wall height (C4P1-086)
major-opening setbacks (3.5 m to 5 m+) dropped
R10-R25 reduction by half an adjoining ROW, pedestrian access way, communal street or battleaxe leg -> pedestrian access way only (C4P1-089)

verified.note: 1m confirmed; Table 3.4a has no coding column, one value for R10-R60; C3.4.1(ii) reads 'For R10-R25'. Table 4A (p7) agrees (1m, R10-R60).

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.1#side-to-3.5m. Table 3.4a (p32) side setback 1 m, the same at every code; C3.4.1(ii) (pedestrian access way, half its width, max 2 m) is limited to R10-R25, so this band carries it as an exception and R30-R60 is a separate rule. No length or major-opening distinction (C4P1-086). Rounding gap between wall-height bands (3.5-3.6 m, 7.0-7.1 m) unresolved. Applies only where the building has walls up to 3.5 m high (condition on building.has_walls_to_3_5m); the band does not depend on the building's maximum wall height.
